verdict.rationale: Riveter documents one-shot scrapes that turn a URL into parseable text, plus AI agents that interpret pages. Nothing in the evidence describes a persistent page session, clicking, form filling, or authenticating past a login wall. Interactive browsing is a fair question for a web-scraping product, so this axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep interacting with an already-scraped page, clicking and filling forms to reach content behind a login wall
